Ultron/Connectors

20 connectors, 95 tools. Every one explained.

A connector is a bundle of tools for one job, like Calendar or YouTube Downloads. Open any of them to see what it does, what to say to use it, and exactly what access it needs. Risky ones stay off until you switch them on.
